name: Cloudinary
description: Search, read and organise the media in your Cloudinary account.
long_description:
Cloudinary's asset-management server. It searches assets, reads their metadata and transformations, and organises folders and tags.

You sign in through Cloudinary in your browser; the scopes cover asset management, upload and media generation.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Cloudinary in your browser. This entry asks for asset management, not upload or generation.

risk.notes: Reaches the media library of the account you sign in to.
